radarchart.description: Compare normalized metrics across one or more series.
radarchart.contract: Provide at least three metrics with values normalized to 0–100. Missing and non-finite values plot at zero; out-of-range values clamp to the chart bounds while source data is preserved. Defaults: 5 grid levels, 60px margin and 1100ms entrance. Each area controls its points, outline and hover glow.
radarchart.keyboard: Tab enters the chart once. Arrow keys, Home and End inspect series; Escape or blur clears the highlight. Reduced motion skips decorative animation. Legend layout and overflow are controlled by API.
radarchart.compatibility: Use RadarGrid, RadarAxis, RadarLabels and RadarArea inside RadarChart. Import shared legends from chart-core. The original observations remain available in the data table.
